routing_warnings.description: The pre-weld completion and prohibition on post-weld machining of surfaces 1 and 2 concern the independently defined welded-face finishing Requirement.
The lost reference-dimension associations and their correction concern drawing dimension integrity rather than the main-shaft fabrication process.
The instruction to retain the holes in the bushing and sliding mandrel belongs to the separate hole-retention Requirement.
The reported missing keyway concerns the sliding mandrel, not the keyway that must be omitted from the main shaft.
The implementation commitment concerns adding the sliding-mandrel keyway and does not affect the main-shaft keyway omission.
The lost associations and subsequent correction concern the narrower Reference Dimension Associativity Requirement rather than general drawing dimension content and presentation.
The color restrictions for drawing views belong to the drawing-view color requirement rather than the file-format package.
The request for STEP and editable 3D model formats belongs to the separate 3D model package requirement.
The instruction to send PDF for confirmation before exporting other formats belongs to the separate PDF-first approval-sequence requirement.
The STEP and native editable SolidWorks part and assembly deliverables belong to the separate 3D model package requirement.
The client's approval of the final drawing revision and authorization to release files concerns the approval sequence, not verification that the required file formats were delivered.

missing_requirement_candidates.description: The message raises an independently consequential choice between a solid construction and a separate ring with ten welded lugs, but its coreferential phrase 'this part' does not identify the main shaft clearly enough to route it to the target Requirement.

missing_requirement_candidates.suggested_title: Bushing Length Relative to Shaft Seat
missing_requirement_candidates.description: The bushing length relative to the machined shaft seat is raised as a separately inspectable geometry issue, but no existing Requirement covers it.
